instruction: Use the two active real whole functions already admitted for bounded whole-function shadow repair. Create a reversible material two-edit defect for each function, with a hidden full-domain oracle not visible to the controller. Run the exact same defects and repair substrate twice: first with the current canonical experience-conditioned cognitive loop as baseline, then with the trained multidomain CODE_RELEASE LOGIC, CODE_REPAIR THINKING, RESOURCE_STRATEGY INTELLIGENCE and multidomain COGNITIVE composition as the controller. The host may only map learned strategy outputs to bounded probe count/release actions; it must not select or write the patch. Require trained hidden/full exactness, hidden isolation, deterministic restore, no worse success than canonical, bounded probe overhead and unchanged canonical G2. Report measured gain separately from transfer success; do not claim gain if baseline is equally good.
